entities.summary: Rose Gertrude Namajunas is an American professional mixed martial artist. She currently competes in the women's Flyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), and is a former two-time UFC Women's Strawweight Champion. As of March 10, 2026, she is #6 in the UFC women's flyweight rankings and #14 in the UFC women's pound-for-pound rankings.
